description: Gold micro-tasks for nano-orchestrator bake-off (v1 frozen). Quality bar: docs/CODE-QUALITY-STANDARD.md

tasks.prompt: Export a pure function filterValues(values, predicate) that returns a new array of numbers matching the predicate. Reject non-arrays with TypeError. Use ES modules.
Export parsePositiveInt(raw) that parses a string to an integer greater than zero. Throw TypeError if raw is not a string. Throw RangeError if the value is not a positive integer.
Export uniqueSorted(nums) that returns a new ascending array of unique numbers. Reject non-arrays with TypeError. Do not mutate the input.
Export groupBy(items, keyFn) that returns a plain object mapping string keys to arrays of items. Reject non-arrays with TypeError.
Export safeJsonParse(text) that returns { ok: true, value } on success or { ok: false, error } with an Error instance on failure. Never throw.
Export debounce(fn, waitMs) that returns a wrapped function delaying calls until waitMs quiet time. Attach a cancel() method that clears the pending timer. No DOM APIs.
Export clamp(n, min, max) that returns n bounded to [min, max]. Throw RangeError if min > max.
Export toQueryString(params) that builds an application/x-www-form-urlencoded query string from a plain object of string values. Skip nullish values. Encode keys and values with encodeURIComponent.
Export deepFreeze(obj) that recursively Object.freeze an object graph (plain objects and arrays). Return the same reference. Ignore non-objects.
Export assertNever(x) that throws TypeError with a message including the unexpected value. Use for exhaustive switch defaults. Return type never.
Write a minimal accessible button labeled Submit inside a form with method post and action /checkout. No inline scripts.
tasks.gold_code:
<form method="post" action="/checkout">
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>

tasks.prompt: Define a macro pageTitle that takes title and prints an h1 with ?html escaping. Then call it with title Dashboard.

tasks.prompt: Given string status, use #switch to print Open, Closed, or Unknown. Escape the label with ?html.
tasks.gold_code:
<#switch status>
  <#case "open">
    ${"Open"?html}
    <#break>
  <#case "closed">
    ${"Closed"?html}
    <#break>
  <#default>
    ${"Unknown"?html}
</#switch>
